descriptions./blog: 了解每项优化的问题、方案、前后证据与适用范围。测量与实施状态分别记录。
descriptions./examples/workflow-analytics: 固定项目 Dashboard、历史口径图表与同快照工作项下钻。
descriptions./examples: 通过完整交互示例了解组件如何组合；每个示例使用本地数据，便于探索布局与状态。
descriptions./examples/work-items: List、Board、Table、Timeline 与 Calendar 共享字段、选择和日期操作。
descriptions./workspace/work-items: Work Items 展示已移至组件示例页面。
descriptions./: 可组合、可修改的 React 组件。从基础交互到完整模块，把源码带进你自己的项目。
descriptions./style-workbench: 并排比较基础样式，实时调整圆角、间距、边框、阴影、颜色和字体，查看参数差异并复制 CSS。
descriptions./dictionary: 通过中文外观、英文名和别名查找 UI 组件、基础样式与视觉效果，比较外观并查看项目用法。
descriptions./scroll: 亲手体验 Scroll-triggered、Scroll-linked、Parallax、Sticky、Scroll Snap 和 Horizontal Scroll 六种滚动交互。
descriptions./workspace: 基于 Component Specification 初始化的紧凑 Agent 工作台，统一尺寸、运行状态和 Inspector。
descriptions./workspace/canvas: 构图、配置、校验与 JSON 导入导出的本地画布工作台。

descriptions./blog: Explore the problem, approach, before and after evidence, and scope of each improvement. Measurement and implementation status are recorded separately.
descriptions./examples/workflow-analytics: A fixed project dashboard, historical metrics and work-item drilldown at the same snapshot.
descriptions./examples: Explore how components fit together in interactive examples. Each example uses local data to demonstrate layouts and states.
descriptions./examples/work-items: List, Board, Table, Timeline and Calendar share fields, selection and date operations.
descriptions./workspace/work-items: The Work Items showcase has moved to the component examples.
descriptions./: Composable, customizable React components. Bring the source into your project, from primitives to complete modules.
descriptions./style-workbench: Compare foundation styles side by side. Adjust radius, spacing, borders, shadows, colors and typography, inspect differences and copy CSS.
descriptions./dictionary: Find UI components, foundations and visual effects by Chinese appearance, English names or aliases. Compare previews and inspect project usage.
descriptions./scroll: Try six scrolling interactions: scroll-triggered, scroll-linked, parallax, sticky, scroll snap and horizontal scroll.
descriptions./workspace: A compact Agent workspace following the Component Specification, with consistent dimensions, runtime states and Inspector.
descriptions./workspace/canvas: A local canvas workspace for graph editing, configuration, validation and JSON import/export.
